cohort: The study included 3965 infertile couples (821 per group after propensity score matching) undergoing their first fresh embryo transfer cycle for IVF/ICSI.
finding: Male HBV infection in couples undergoing IVF/ICSI significantly reduces the live birth rate, increases the abortion rate, and leads to significantly lower rates of high-quality embryos and blastocyst formation, though it does not increase the incidence of low birth weight.
